overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Committee's December 14 meeting never convened without a quorum, and the Council properly adjourned and rescheduled its meeting after live-broadcast failures.

allegations.summary: Complaints alleged the Council and its Committee of the Whole held December 14 meetings that were not broadcast live on ECTV, as the notices said they would be.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Council and the Committee did not violate the Open Meeting Law on December 14.
